pages.title: Pricing — StackPilot
pages.html:
[stackpilot]
  • Plans
  • Compare
  • FAQ
  • Get Started

Simple, Transparent Pricing for Every Stage

StackPilot grows with your team. Every plan includes unlimited projects, automatic backups, and core deployment tooling — the only thing that changes is how much scale and support you need. No hidden fees, no surprise overages, cancel anytime.

Choose Your Plan

Starter

$19/month

For solo developers shipping their first production app.

  • 1 team member
  • 5 active projects
  • 10 GB storage
  • Community support
  • Daily backups
Start with Starter
Most Popular

Growth

$49/month

For small teams that need collaboration and more horsepower.

  • 10 team members
  • Unlimited projects
  • 100 GB storage
  • Priority email support
  • Hourly backups
  • Staging environments
Start with Growth

Scale

$129/month

For growing companies with demanding uptime and compliance needs.

  • Unlimited team members
  • Unlimited projects
  • 1 TB storage
  • 24/7 phone & chat support
  • Real-time backups
  • SSO & audit logs
Start with Scale

Full Feature Comparison

Compare every feature across Starter, Growth, and Scale
Feature Starter Growth Scale
Team members 1 10 Unlimited
Active projects 5 Unlimited Unlimited
Storage 10 GB 100 GB 1 TB
Backup frequency Daily Hourly Real-time
Staging environments — Yes Yes
Custom domains 1 5 Unlimited
Role-based access control — Basic Advanced
Single sign-on (SSO) — — Yes
Audit logs — — Yes
Uptime SLA — 99.5% 99.95%
Support Community forum Priority email 24/7 phone & chat
API rate limit 1,000 req/day 50,000 req/day Unlimited

Billing & Plan Questions

Can I switch plans later?

Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade at any time from your account settings. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated; downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.

Is there a free trial?

Every plan includes a 14-day free trial with full access to that plan's features. No credit card is required to start a trial.

Do you offer annual billing?

Yes. Paying annually saves you the equivalent of two months on any plan. You can switch between monthly and annual billing from your billing dashboard.

What happens if I exceed my storage limit?

We'll email you before you reach your limit. You can either upgrade to the next plan or purchase additional storage blocks at $5 per 10 GB per month.

Can I cancel anytime?

Absolutely. There are no long-term contracts. Cancel anytime from your account settings and you'll retain access until the end of your current billing period.

Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or startups?

Yes, we offer 30% off the Growth and Scale plans for registered nonprofits and early-stage startups. Contact us at hello@stackpilot.io to apply.

Ready to Get Started?

Enter your details below and we'll set up your 14-day free trial — no credit card required.
